digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter hierarchy / parent field outbound reconciliation
propositions: DC silently accepts and ignores fields.parent writes on sub-tasks instead of rejecting or applying them (req-0056/0058 reproduced live)

A non-epic parent in rebar's local state returns (False, None) from _resolve_local_parent indistinguishable from unbound retry, causing the entire record_parent_divergence / bridge_alerts apparatus to be unreachable and passes to exit 0 reporting convergence while parent diverges

Two test oracles (inbound/outbound set_subtask_parent round-trips) are wrong because they assert operations on sub-task parents that DC cannot perform; the correct mechanism is Epic Link on non-sub-task children (already green in run 30951453979)
The emit-side parent suppression guard (8b25) must not lift but must record suppressed parents as durable bridge alerts when they diverge from the tracker, not fail silently

Re-homing three failing cells to Epic Link and unsupported-case semantics while preserving their user-visible subjects (child reaches intended parent locally; unsupported reparent surfaced loudly) resolves all three reds without deletion/skip/xfail
